dedupe_keys.name: second life ev battery long term cycling and test recipes

description: Loughborough University publishes long-term cycling tests of electric-vehicle batteries reused for stationary storage. Coverage is six documented laboratory use cases. The version 2 repository release groups results by six use cases, including photovoltaic self-consumption, time-of-use tariffs and frequency-response services. Its file list includes the data ZIP, test recipes, a changelog, requirements and Jupyter notebooks for conversion and cycle processing. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0. The observations can calibrate degradation and dispatch assumptions in second-life storage simulations, with model-pypsa providing a related power-system modelling context. A caveat is that controlled cycler results do not directly predict performance of every retired pack, installation or battery-management system. Actual test temperatures, usable capacity histories and cycle-selection rules need file-level review before parameter transfer. The public metadata, manifest and article data-record explanation were read; the test archives and notebooks were not downloaded or executed.
